# Unregistered local page jump causes navigateTo failure
houseLoanGuide/index.vue jumped to an unregistered page pages/policy/fddydetail (not in pages.json), causing navigateTo:fail page not found.

## Problem
- houseLoanGuide/index.vue navigated to pages/policy/fddydetail missing from pages.json
- Triggered navigateTo:fail page not found error

## Solution
- Open the external H5 page via webViewNav instead of navigateTo
- Implemented in zhi2-mobile-shimin/src/pages_transaction/houseLoanGuide/index.vue goToDetail method

# WXSS local background image causes render-layer error
In pages_owner/house/index.vue, WXSS background images for .top-empty and .history-container used local paths, causing render-layer network errors in WeChat mini-program.

## Problem
- pages_owner/house/index.vue used local-path WXSS backgrounds for .top-empty and .history-container
- WeChat mini-program could not load local paths, producing render-layer network errors

## Solution
- Conditional compilation: H5 uses local ../../static/images/szf/Bg-szf.png; mini-program uses CDN https://szf.szzfcjj.cn:8888/static/images/szf/Bg-szf.png

# uni.chooseFile unsupported in mini-program causes upload error
ImageUploader.vue called uni.chooseFile directly, unsupported in WeChat mini-program, causing a TypeError on the pages_owner/house/owner/register upload page.

## Problem
- ImageUploader.vue used uni.chooseFile, unsupported in WeChat mini-program
- TypeError occurred during upload on pages_owner/house/owner/register

## Solution
- Select API by platform: H5 uses uni.chooseFile; images use uni.chooseImage; video uses uni.chooseMedia
- Extracted uploadSelectedFile to handle temp paths without extensions
